name: duk-bustracker
description: DUK BusTracker repository containing backend API and frontend mobile app

scripts.android: adb reverse tcp:5004 tcp:5004 && cd frontend && npx react-native run-android --no-packager
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run android"
scripts.dev:ios: npx concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run ios"
